sahne: A generous Turkish breakfast spread on a rustic wooden table in soft morning window light: slices of crusty bread, a block of white cheese, black and green olives, halved boiled eggs, a small bowl of golden honey, a handful of walnuts, sliced tomatoes and cucumbers, and two tulip-shaped glasses of red-brown tea on small saucers. Three-quarter top view, appetizing and natural. No text, no logos, no packaging with labels.

A school chemistry demonstration on a dark lab bench: on the left, a tuft of steel wool held in metal crucible tongs burns brilliantly with dazzling white-orange sparks inside a tall clear glass gas jar of pure oxygen; on the right, an identical tuft of steel wool held in tongs in the open air only glows a dull orange-red with a few sparks. Dark background so the difference in brightness is obvious, safety goggles resting on the bench. No text, no labels, no logos.

Two small fires side by side on a flat stone fire pit at dusk, made from the same kind of pale pine wood: on the left, a single thick round log that is only charring slowly with a few small, low flames; on the right, a loose heap of fine wood shavings and sawdust burning in a tall, vigorous, bright yellow flame. The contrast in flame size is clear. No people, no text, no logos.

Close-up of two halves of the same apple lying cut side up on a wooden cutting board: the left half freshly cut, crisp and creamy white; the right half cut about half an hour earlier, its flesh evenly turned light golden-brown from browning. A kitchen knife lies behind them. Soft natural window light, shallow depth of field. No text, no logos.
